description: This PHP class 'RequestParams' encapsulates the handling, validation, and retrieval of HTTP request parameters, including query parameters, URL attributes, and request body data, with support for various data types, File attachments, date/time parsing, and special sanitization for SVG content.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: Handles retrieval and validation of different request parameters (body, attributes, query) in a web API context, supports multiple data types, date parsing, file attachment processing, and SVG sanitization.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter from specified parameter bag type, returning default if not present.

methods.name: getStringOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter or null, with optional conversion of empty strings to null.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter, throws exception if parameter is an empty string.

methods.name: getIntOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter or null.

methods.name: getFloatOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a float parameter or null.

methods.name: getBooleanOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter or null.

methods.name: getArrayOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves an array parameter or null.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a file attachment, returning null if not present.

methods.name: getAttachmentOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves a file attachment or null. Sanitizes SVG files.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Parses and returns a DateTime object from request parameter, considering optional timezone.

methods.name: getDateTimeOrNull
methods.description: Parses and returns a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in the specified bag.
